summary: This re-mint fixes the only blocking issue of the held attn-full-prefill-cuda-fp8-wgmma-hard-gate: the child-process first launch is now an in-process guarded canary, which LESSONS 2026-10-25 line 143 prescribes. The sm_90a build fix, the deletion of mma.sync, exp offload at 0/8 and the hard cold-L2 graph gate at <=0.92x FA3 make every per-class outcome self-attributing, so run it as an okc check.
justification: A: The target is real and the floor can be reached. FINDINGS profiles FA3's cutlass device_kernel at 415.4 us on turn_1 full (26.8%), 1620.2 us on turn_4 full (32.8%), and 4467 and 8017 us on first_turn full at ctx32768/65536 (22.9% and 36.6%). That is about 1.6x the exp floors of 250/1000/555/2770/4990 us, so M2 (0.75x FA3, about 1.2x floor) is physically reachable. Expected directions agree with TASK.md: full classes are faster or flat by construction, and sliding layers are flat because FA3 is untouched. The headline stake is small. FA3 on full layers is about 7-11% of each load, so one class routed at the 0.92 threshold moves its load by about 0.6-0.9%, inside the +-1.5% CI. This stage must therefore be read from the GATE lines, PATH CHOSEN and the profile's top_kernels, which is correct for kind: rewrite. Weakest link: the ported wgmma core has never been compiled or run. The predecessor f5c30b15 silently measured the mma.sync fallback, at 3.07-3.21x FA3. The core is also not warp-specialized, ping-pong or persistent, while FA3 overlaps softmax with the QK/PV wgmma. The most likely outcomes are M0 with every class gated to FA3 (ratios of about 0.95-1.4x), or a self-check failure that turns the path OFF. Both are still readable measurements that set stage 2's design. The residual hard risk is an illegal-instruction or async fault in the first wgmma launch. That poisons the context, try/except cannot recover it, and the run fails 0/5. Running it as an okc check, never a scored submit, with a sync and a print per kernel, bounds that cost to one check and names the faulting kernel. Secondary: cudaFuncGetAttributes binaryVersion reports 90 for both sm_90 and sm_90a, so the image proof comes from the single-gencode build line plus the FEAT_SM90_ALL error flag, not from binaryVersion alone. prepare() must also fit in 300 s: about 40 s of nvcc, master's existing Triton warmup and self-checks, and 5 classes x 2 paths x >=20 cold-L2 replays. That is small, about 2 s even at ctx65536, but log the total prepare seconds.
confounders: None material. stack-tonight-five-prefill, experts-triton-w4a16-first-turn-blockt256 and experts-hybrid-marlin-turn-triton-first-turn touch router, align, w2 zero-store, silu-mul and the expert GEMMs. All of these run after attn_boundary, and master's side stream starts after attention, so nothing overlaps or shares memory traffic with the FA3 call. Master's attention code is byte-identical to the base of the old regression run.

sglang-pipeline-parity defines the incumbent: a paged page_size-1 FA3 call with scheduler_metadata None on prefill, causal, plus FlashAttnFwdCombine. The gate must time exactly that call, with its combine, against the new kernel plus attn_combine_kernel. Any difference (for example omitting the q FP8 cast on one side) biases the ratio, so both captured graphs should include or exclude the q cast identically.
interference: No companion is warranted. The change replaces only the full-layer attention call, and no landed hypothesis shares its launch sequence, memory traffic or numerics, so neither an ab-revert nor an ab-tune would isolate anything. The hard gate makes each shape class self-attributing: per class, the log prints FA3 us, new us, the ratio and the route, and the profile shows which kernel ran. The one internal sub-change worth a control, exp offload, is already removed (0/8). For a rewrite, the next stage is the follow-up.
rules_flags: Process rule: satisfied for the self-check. The child process is gone. load_inline itself shells out to nvcc/ninja, but the earlier load_inline runs (f5c30b15, experts-cuda-wgmma-mixed-input-grouped-gemm) passed the static checks with checks.ok=true, so this is the accepted pattern. Do not add any other subprocess call (cuobjdump, nvidia-smi, subprocess, multiprocessing).

CUDA graphs / input values: _full_attn_gate and _attn_splits must branch only on shapes and config (batch, q_len, page_table.shape[1] bucket, page_size, window, kv_scale), never on seq_lens or cache_seqlens values. The split count must be shape-derived. The page_table width bucket must be wide enough that the judge's dist=soft widths at turn_4 and turn_1 (max seq_len + L, which varies with seed) land in the bucket that was timed. Otherwise the class silently falls to FA3, which is safe but shows as all-FA3.
Fresh inputs: the gate decision is computed in prepare() on synthetic inputs and keyed on config only. That is legal. Nothing derived from data may be cached.

Every key: the causal mask may skip only fully-future tiles. No past-context tile may be skipped, and no value may be dropped by weight. The self-check against FA3 must keep the outliers case and the b4 {0,777,5000,80000} mixed-length case.
Precision: queries in FP8 E4M3 and P in FP8 for the PV wgmma match FA3's FP8 path (allowed). The output must return in the same dtype and layout as FA3's before o_norm_gate.
Process: the first measurement must be okc check, never submit. The predecessor f5c30b15 was a scored submit (0.881) and had to be withdrawn or absorbed.
open_questions: Does the gate's synthetic turn_4 input use a dist=soft per-request length spread close to the judge's, so that the split, causal-tail balance and combine work match the judge? Equal lengths can flatter or penalize the new kernel relative to FA3.

What is master's prepare() wall time today? Log the build seconds, self-check seconds and gate seconds separately, so stacking with the queued CUDA expert rewrite can be budgeted against the 300 s limit.

Does the ported core double-buffer K/V (cp.async or TMA) while the wgmma runs? If K/V loads are serialized with the MMAs, expect ratios of about 1.3x or worse, and stage 2 should go straight to a warp-specialized producer/consumer ping-pong instead of tuning tiles.
The held sibling attn-full-prefill-cuda-fp8-wgmma-hard-gate (archive) should stay held and be marked superseded by this slug, so it is never dispatched.
